systems.system: Huawei and iFlytek AI data centre proposal: civil registry integration
systems.owner: proposed by Huawei to the Egyptian government; not adopted in the document
systems.tiers: a 102-page proposal reported on 26 August 2026 lists recognition of vehicles and individuals against a national population database and civil registry integration among its applications

note: An analyst's commentary on a vendor bid: the civil registry appears only as something the proposed AI system would integrate with; nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
